items.description: Changed Reader items, oldest change first. An item appears once per walk, at its latest change.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor to pass as `after`. Always present, also when caught up, so the client can poll from it later.

caught_up.description: True when this page reached the end of the feed as it was when the page was read.

change_seq.description: Sequence number of the item's latest change. It only grows.

kinds.description: What changed since the client was last caught up: capture, revision, tags, annotations, note, reading_state, media, enrichment, triage, routing, collections. A client must ignore a kind it does not know.
